verdict.rationale: Llama weights can be downloaded under a stated license, the Llama Community License, with per-family license, model card, and use-policy files. Downloads come from the official Hugging Face org or via a Meta signed URL using the llama-model CLI, which includes integrity verification. Meta documents running the weights locally on desktop, mobile, and edge through llama.cpp and ExecuTorch, and the community confirms the license allows commercial use but is not OSI open source and has a 700M MAU carve-out. Missing for 10: download is gated behind a request/approval step rather than immediate, and there is no independent hands-on report of the download-and-run flow.
